name: agent-office
description: Connects Claude Code to Agent Office: finds the office server of your project by itself, shows your team working in a 3D office, runs the tasks you type there, and adds a team launched mid-session as agents.

officeUrl.title: Office URL (optional)
officeUrl.description: Leave empty: the plugin finds the office of the session's project by itself. Set a local address (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) only to force one office for every project.

showTask.title: Show task text
showTask.description: Send the first 200 characters of each prompt you submit, so the office can show the task in its meeting. Off sends that a task started, with no text.

showMessages.title: Show message text
showMessages.description: Send the first 200 characters of each message between agents, for the speech bubbles. Off sends who talked to whom, with no text.

registerTeam.title: Add a newly launched team
registerTeam.description: When you launch a team while this session is open, add its agents to this session right away (new sessions read them from .claude/agents/ by themselves).

acceptTasks.title: Take tasks from the office page
acceptTasks.description: Start each task typed on the office page as a prompt in this session. Off leaves page tasks to other sessions of the project.
